markdown: > **Correction, 24/09/2026 (before publication).** The sentence "each was published into the confirmed tier carrying a date that was already behind it" says more than G6 shows, and R12 requires the page to say where the four copies do not settle the question. The gated copies are not consecutive: no copy is held between 19/05/2026 and 22/08/2026 (95 days). Fifteen of the 17 first read `2` on 22/08/2026, and for 7 of those 15 (Whitelaw Brae Windfarm, Persley Croft BESS, Holmston Farm Battery Energy Storage System, Lovat Estate BESS, Windy Standard III Wind Farm, Balbougie Energy Centre, Whitelaw Brae BESS; 293.3 MW) the date fell inside that gap, so they may have entered the tier in a copy not held here while the date was still ahead. For them the four copies do not settle it. For the other 10 the date had already passed in the last gated copy before the first that reads `2`. A `blank` Gate cell in that earlier copy is not interpreted (R10), so even for those 10 this is a statement about the copies held, not about when NESO assessed them. The sentence above is kept as written; this note governs it. The 7 and 10 are a reading of the committed G6 rows and are not promoted to any slot.
